title: Repository-wide governance gate and evidence hardening
reason: Replace change-local RuoYi baseline exceptions with hash-bound project baselines; repair context/finalize/review evidence binding, Java test ownership, runtime and production-build checks, and real CI coverage without weakening new-change detection.
oldRule: RuoYi legacy component and boundary findings were repeatedly copied into the active change exception Markdown and matched by path substring or allow-all text.
A boundary exception could skip every finding in one file instead of consuming one reviewed file-target edge.
Review approval, changed-files evidence, current context, Java test ownership, CI coverage, phase-gate scanning, and runtime execution were not all bound to exact repository facts.
newRule: Stable imported RuoYi findings live in ai/rules/ruoyi-legacy-baseline.json and are accepted only by exact file/check or file/target identity plus canonical SHA256.
Current-change component and boundary exceptions require structured file, check or target, and reason fields; the exact file must exist in the current changed-files.json.
Wildcards, directory scopes, allow-all switches, prose substring matches, and whole-file boundary skips are forbidden.
Review approval, changed-files evidence, current context, Java tests, CI commands, executable phase-gate files, and Maven reactor execution must bind to the exact facts recorded by their owning gate.

Git evidence must retain every path reported by Git, use fixed full commit OIDs, and reject non-canonical edit roots; business reviews must predate implementation and remain unchanged in its Git range.
acceptanceConstraints: The proposal authorizes governance-only implementation inside the active rule-change impact roots.
Business runtime files and the production application profile remain outside this proposal.
beforeSalesOrder remains blocked and this proposal does not authorize release or deployment.
The proposal remains accepted until implementation evidence, full gates, and closeout are complete; it must not be marked implemented early.
checklist: Explain old rule and new rule.
List sample files proving the project base needs this rule.
Run npm run check after the rule proposal is accepted.
